classification.difficultyReason: Plot corresponding points and interpret their horizontal and vertical displacement, including movement across the horizontal axis and a purely vertical translation.

content.prompt: Given a point and its image under translation in each part, plot the points and describe each translation.

answer.worked: Plot $A(0,0)$ and $A'(3,1)$. From $A$, count 3 squares right and 1 square up to reach $A'$. The translation is 3 units right and 1 unit up.
Plot $B(1,-3)$ and $B'(6,2)$. From $B$, count 5 squares right and 5 squares up to reach $B'$. The translation is 5 units right and 5 units up.
Plot $C(0,3)$ and $C'(0,-3)$ on the $y$-axis. From $C$, count 6 squares down to reach $C'$. There is no horizontal movement. The translation is 6 units down.

spec.sourceRegion: Review exercise question 7; completed plot from teacher PDF page 57
spec.description: One shared Cartesian solution graph showing all six labelled points. Grid step is one coordinate unit in both directions. The graph is supplied only in answer editions.
